svg.aria-label: Mercalli: live outage intelligence with forecasts of how long incidents will last
svg.text: What is broken, how long it will last, and what it will hit next.
A seismograph of internet incidents, one row per hour
status pages watched, refreshed every 5 minutes
of outcomes inside its 80% ranges, unseen data
services cited AWS within 3 hours, 20 Oct 2025
